title: Anime opening
pitch: Three key visuals, each brought to life, cut to a driving track.
why: Anima draws the frames, H3 keeps the drawn look when it moves them, and the cut follows the music like a TV opening.

fields.label: The story
fields.default: a young pilot and a towering black and gold mecha in a rain-soaked neon city

models.name: MiniMax H3
models.note: Show the name in commercial products. Read the licence's territory terms before you rely on it.

models.licence: MiniMax-Music3 Community License (the ComfyUI repackage is tagged Apache-2.0; the upstream text is treated as the one that applies)
models.note: Commercial use must show the name MiniMax-Music3.

models.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: Keep realism words out of the prompts (photo, 35mm, film grain): the owner's anime rule.

steps.label: Cut on the beat
steps.what: Finds the tempo and beats in the song, picks its loudest section, and cuts each clip on a beat. Loudness normalized.

expected.basis: sum of each step's measured time on this box, with a cold start per step

raw_steps.label: Key visual 1
raw_steps.prompt: {story}, wide shot, the city below, rain, glowing green visor

raw_steps.label: Key visual 2
raw_steps.prompt: close-up of the young pilot looking up in the rain, neon reflected in her eyes, from {story}

raw_steps.label: Key visual 3
raw_steps.prompt: the mecha rises to full height over the city, gold light bursting behind it, from {story}

raw_steps.label: Move 1
raw_steps.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, anime. Rain falls across the frame and the green visor flickers on. The camera pushes in at slow speed. One continuous shot, no cuts.

overall_soundscape: Rain and a low electric hum.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

raw_steps.label: Move 2
raw_steps.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, anime. She lifts her chin and her hair moves in the wind, neon sliding across her face. The camera stays close and pushes in with small amplitude. One continuous shot, no cuts.

overall_soundscape: Rain and distant city sound.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

raw_steps.label: Move 3
raw_steps.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, anime. The mecha straightens to its full height and gold light bursts behind it. The camera tilts up with large amplitude. One continuous shot, no cuts.

overall_soundscape: A deep mechanical rumble.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

raw_steps.label: Opening track
raw_steps.prompt:
Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 138. J-Rock, anime opening.
Global Emotional Progression: A short riff intro snaps into a driving, soaring theme.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: Under picture from start to finish.
Sonics & Production Profile: A clean, wide mix with a steady pulse that is easy to cut to.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: No vocals. Purely instrumental.
Vocal Style: No vocals.
Harmony/Backing Vocals: None.
Vocal FX: None.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: driving electric guitars, fast drums, bright synth lead.
Secondary: Soft pads and quiet textures that widen as it builds.
Groove & Foundation Progression: A clear, even 138 BPM pulse from the first bars, with percussion joining as it grows.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Risers and swells into each new section.
